The Story

From sketches to systems.

I started with drawing and portraits, then trained in Graphics and Visual Design at Arena Animation. Since then, my work has grown across graphic design, 3D product visualisation and UX research. My engineering background gives me a practical approach to design, while my experience at GM Modular, university projects and Hilton Birmingham Metropole has shaped how I create visual and digital experiences.
